competitors.name: One Planet Pizza
competitors.action: One Planet Pizza crossed £1 million in annualized retail sales and secured a third Asda listing rolling out nationwide on May 11, while also extending Peppernomi into 255 Co-op stores, a strong signal that differentiated frozen pizza can still win mainstream grocery doors when the proposition is sharp enough.

competitors.name: Dr. Oetker / La Mia Familia
competitors.action: Dr. Oetker said its La Mia Familia pizza bites line, launched in Germany, the Netherlands, and Spain, will add a garlic variant in May 2026 and expand into additional countries, showing a major incumbent is pushing frozen pizza into snackable, shareable formats rather than staying inside the classic round-pie lane.

competitors.name: Nomad Foods / For Real! Foods
competitors.action: Nomad Foods advanced Swedish startup For Real! Foods into concept development through its Future Foods Lab after highlighting the brand's clean-label, allergen-friendly frozen pizzas, a meaningful sign that one of Europe's biggest frozen-food operators is actively scouting better-for-you pizza formats for possible pilot and scale.

trends.topic: Frozen pizza innovation is spreading into sharper sub-lanes instead of generic premiumization
trends.magnitude: Plant-based grocery scale, snackable pizza-bite line extensions, and clean-label functional pizza incubation all surfaced in the same cycle.
trends.context: The category is fragmenting around very specific consumer jobs: dairy-free mainstream shoppers, social snacking occasions, and health-oriented freezer buyers. Real Dough should keep its own claim equally crisp and ownable around authentic sourdough and craft quality.

breaking.headline: The strongest new signal today is format fragmentation, not one dominant frozen-pizza playbook.
breaking.impact: Winning brands are not just saying premium. They are pairing a very specific format or shopper promise with scaled retail distribution. Real Dough should keep tightening its shelf story so it sounds as concrete as these emerging lane leaders.
